name.ja: <ruby>黒<rt>こく</rt></ruby><ruby>犬<rt>けん</rt></ruby><ruby>獣<rt>じゅう</rt></ruby>バウ

text.en: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 Level 7 or higher DARK monster with 2500 DEF, 1 "Stairway to the Underworld", or 1 "Domain of the Dark Ruler" from your Deck to your hand. If this card is Tributed or banished: You can target 1 Counter Trap in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Bau the Black Dog Beast" once per turn.
